versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-video2text-ai.

- Converts video (via URL or local file) to clean text using a cloud-based large language model.
- Supports customizable output with prompts for summarization, rewriting, highlights extraction, translation, meeting minutes, and more.
- Removes filler words, mistakes, and repetition for ready-to-use copy.
- Works with popular video platforms (e.g., Douyin, Xiaohongshu) as well as local files.
- Requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for authentication. Data is securely handled and auto-deleted after use.
- Command-line interface with clear parameters; integrates easily into custom content workflows.
